 UAE School Holidays 2026-2029: Full Academic Calendar and Key Dates for Parents
 The UAE Ministry of Education has published the unified academic calendar for 2026-27, 2027-28 and 2028-29. The three-year framework outlines official school start dates, winter and spring breaks, and end-of-year timelines for public and private schools. Here’s a complete breakdown of UAE school holidays and term dates through 2029.
 Share 
 By Susan Roberts
 The Report
 Local education top stories, summarised for you.
 Thank you for subscribing to our mailing list.
 First published: 24th Feb 2026
 Updated: 30th Oct 2026
 By Susan Roberts
 When is the next school holiday in the UAE? With the October half-term break now over, many families are already looking ahead to the winter holidays, which begin on Monday, 14 December 2026, for schools following the UAE's unified academic calendar.
 LATEST: UAE Flag Day 2026: Date, Time, School Celebrations and Is It a Public Holiday? 
 The good news for parents planning family holidays, trips overseas or childcare arrangements is that the UAE Ministry of Education (MoE) has confirmed school term dates for three academic years, covering 2026-27, 2027-28 and 2028-29.
 The calendar sets out when schools start and finish, along with the dates for October half-term, winter holidays and spring break, giving families a clearer picture of the school year well in advance.
 However, not every private school in the UAE follows exactly the same holiday schedule. Some schools have flexibility over mid-term breaks, while schools following Indian, Pakistani and Bangladeshi curricula typically operate on a different academic calendar.
 Here is our WhichSchoolAdvisor guide to the UAE school holidays and academic calendar through to summer 2029, including the important dates parents need to know. 
 When Is the Next UAE School Holiday?
 4 December 2026 – 3 January 2027
 UAE Winter School Holidays 2026–27
 Schools reopen Monday, 4 January 2027
 The last scheduled school day before the winter break is Friday, 11 December 2026.

 Who Must Follow the Unified UAE Academic Calendar?
 The MoE has confirmed that:
 All public and private schools across the UAE must adhere to the official calendar.
 Final assessments and curriculum completion must take place in the last week of each term to ensure students attend until the final school day.
 An exception applies to grades sitting for pre-scheduled international examinations.

 The next main school holiday is winter break, beginning Monday, 14 December 2026. Schools following the unified calendar reopen on Monday, 4 January 2027.
 Are UAE schools closed for National Day in December 2026? 
 The Ministry's 2026–27 academic calendar lists 2 and 3 December as National Day holidays. Parents should check their individual school announcements for the final arrangements.
 When is the UAE spring school holiday in 2027? 
 Spring break is scheduled from 5 to 11 April 2027, with schools reopening on Monday, 12 April.
 When do UAE schools finish for summer 2027? 
 The official final day is Friday, 2 July 2027, under the main unified calendar. Dates may differ for schools operating under separate regulatory arrangements.
 When do UAE schools reopen after summer 2027? 
 The new academic year begins on Monday, 30 August 2027.
 Do Indian curriculum schools follow these dates? 
 Not generally. Many Indian curriculum schools in the UAE follow an April-to-March academic year, with different term dates and holidays.
